items.name: hook_hi
items.direction: Narrate this in natural spoken Hindi, the way a popular Indian geography explainer YouTube Shorts channel talks. Numbers and English words are read in English. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, a short comic pause before each punchline, a little awe on the depth reveals. Chars voices funny cartoon characters (a pompous, touchy Lake Superior; a weary deadpan Belgium), short and punchy. This is the opening line of the Short: punchy and intriguing, a little stress on 'ज़्यादा पानी'.
lines: ये एक झील, पाँचों Great Lakes को मिलाकर भी, उनसे ज़्यादा पानी रखती है।
